output.synthesis: The frozen studies report faster processing without a measured error-rate change.
limitations: The two studies used different trial counts.
The fixtures do not establish causality.

claims.claim: Study Alpha reported a 12 percent processing-time reduction.
Study Beta reported no material error-rate change.

citations.quote: Study Alpha observed a 12 percent reduction in processing time across 40 trials.
Study Beta reported no material change in error rate across 35 trials.
